where: the no-op lane on an ix VM
what: On the lane's VM no build is answered by the no-op lane: every walk looks at `/nix/store/...-glibc-.../lib/crtn.o` on the disk (`no-op answer: ... crtn.o, which no watch covers, so each build looks at it on the disk`), so its answer is never kept. A build with nothing changed is a walk there (0.14 s for hello world).
cost: the lane's own behaviour for a client shown diagnostics another way could be seen only in its simulation, not on the VM
cause: the linker's startup objects are under /nix/store, outside every watch
